entries.title: Psalms 30:1
segments: ¶<<A Psalm. A Song at the dedication of the house of David.>> I will extol You, O LORD, for You have lifted me up, And have not let my foes rejoice over me.

entries.title: Psalms 30:2
segments: O LORD my God, I cried out to You, And You healed me.

entries.title: Psalms 30:3
segments: O LORD, You brought my soul up from the grave; You have kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.

entries.title: Psalms 30:4
segments: Sing praise to the LORD, You saints of His, And give thanks at the remembrance of His holy name.

entries.title: Psalms 30:5
segments: For His anger [is but for] a moment, His favor [is for] life; Weeping may endure for a night, But joy [comes] in the morning.

entries.title: Psalms 30:6
segments: ¶Now in my prosperity I said, "I shall never be moved."

entries.title: Psalms 30:7
segments: LORD, by Your favor You have made my mountain stand strong; You hid Your face, [and] I was troubled.

entries.title: Psalms 30:8
segments: I cried out to You, O LORD; And to the LORD I made supplication:

entries.title: Psalms 30:9
segments: "What profit [is there] in my blood, When I go down to the pit? Will the dust praise You? Will it declare Your truth?

entries.title: Psalms 30:10
segments: Hear, O LORD, and have mercy on me; LORD, be my helper!"

entries.title: Psalms 30:11
segments: You have turned for me my mourning into dancing; You have put off my sackcloth and clothed me with gladness,

entries.title: Psalms 30:12
segments: To the end that [my] glory may sing praise to You and not be silent. O LORD my God, I will give thanks to You forever.
